title: The mark of the mental is content or quality, not consciousness

statements.text: A state is mental because it has intentional content or sensory quality, not because it is conscious. Beliefs, desires, emotions and perceptions often occur without being conscious, so consciousness can be explained as a further property of some mental states.

sources.quote: Such an explanation is possible only if we adopt the non-Cartesian view that intentional and sensory character are jointly the mark of the mental.

Many sorts of mental state, such as beliefs, desires, hopes, expectations, aspirations, various emotions, and arguably even some bodily feelings such as aches, often occur in us without our noticing their presence.
